issues.legal_issue: Pre-existing land acquisition proceedings and associated compensation liabilities remained with the transferor under the scheme of arrangement when they were not transferred to the acquiring company.

The transferor, rather than the acquiring company, was liable under the scheme of arrangement to pay compensation determined by a supplementary award for land acquired in the pre-existing proceedings.
Acquired land used as a safety zone is not eligible for return under Section 101 of the 2013 Act when it has not remained unutilised for the prescribed period.

The State has a constitutional and statutory duty to ensure prompt payment of full compensation for acquired land, even when the ultimate acquisition cost is payable by the company for whose benefit the land was acquired.

Taking possession before determining and paying full compensation, including compensation to be fixed by a supplementary award, contravenes the statutory requirements governing possession and acquisition for a company.
